title: A MESSAGE FROM #MATTHEW THE #MARTYR
segments: after the Ascension of our Lord Jesus
Christ I embarked on a mission is
instructed by him to go and make
disciples of all
Nations filled with the Holy Spirit I
traveled to various regions sharing the
good news wherever I went it was during
my travels that I sensed a calling to
visit Ethiopia a great land rich in
history
culture i fervently preach the gospel
before you sharing stories of Jesus life
death and resurrection and his message
of Salvation to our brothers scattered
here word of my teachings quickly spread
throughout the land reaching the ears of
the Ethiopian king and queen who were
curious and wanted to hear more about
this man named Jesus as I Shar the
teachings with them
their hearts were filled with faith and
soon they received it becoming devoted
followers of
Christ however some influential people
in the Ethiopian Court threatened by the
spread of the Gospel plotted against
me their hatred for the gospel blinded
them to the truth and led to their
desire to silence me even through
violent means so even in the face of
imminent death my faith in Jesus will
never waver I stand firm watching the
ripple effect of my teachings touch the
lives of many who had embraced it you'll
sentence me to death hoping to
extinguish the fire of my message bound
and led to this place of execution I
face my final moments with unwavering
resolve I pray for those who persecuted
me asking God to forgive them for their
ignorance as my life is taken from me I
take my last breath knowing that my
sacrifice would not be in vain I believe
that the seeds of faith I had planted in
Ethiopia would continue to grow and bear
fruit long after I'm gone do as you
please
